title: Rolling Reserve Rate and Hold Period, Northloop Payments
content:
The rolling reserve rate is the share of each sale credit additionally held as a rolling reserve, stated as a decimal fraction; the rolling reserve hold days are the calendar days a rolling reserve is held from the sale credit date, not applicable when the rate is zero. Both are terms of the Northloop Payments payout plan.

| Payout plan | Rolling reserve rate | Rolling reserve hold days |
|---|---|---|
| Payments Starter | 0.1 (10%) | 90 |
| Payments Biweekly | 0 | not applicable |
| Payments Weekly | 0 | not applicable |
| Payments Daily | 0 | not applicable |
| Payments Daily Plus | 0 | not applicable |
| Payments Enterprise | 0 | not applicable |

Only Payments Starter carries a rolling reserve: 10% of each sale credit, held for 90 calendar days from the sale credit date. On the five other plans the rate is zero and no hold period applies.

*Hypothetical example.* On Payments Starter a sale credit of 240.00 USD carries a rolling reserve of 24.00 USD (240.00 multiplied by 0.1), held 90 calendar days from the date of that sale credit.
